verdict.rationale: Morph's docs say any OpenAI SDK can be pointed at `https://api.morphllm.com/v1`, and that existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string. They also describe moving production agents off OpenAI or Anthropic via canary traffic splits, and offer an Anthropic Messages endpoint as well. A community user independently confirmed the OpenAI-compatible endpoint worked with their own CLI tool. Missing for 10: documented parity details (e.g. tool calling and streaming behavior) for the compatible endpoint that would confirm agents can swap providers mid-workflow with no edge-case changes.
